changeSet.author: Axelix Team
changeSet.comment: Drops users.job_title and users.organizational_unit. They were stored since 1.1 but never exposed for configuration, and Axelix no longer keeps them. Native ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN is used instead of dropColumn, because the latter makes Liquibase rebuild the whole table on SQLite, which users_roles references (see 1.1-011).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN job_title;
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN organizational_unit;
